title: Development of an LLM Pipeline Surpassing Physicians in Cardiovascular Risk Score Calculation

live_model.evidence: Supplementary Table 4, HAS-BLED / LLM Pipeline row: "GPT-4 Turbo 0.85 [0.56, 1.00] 0.26 [0.15, 0.35]" (Krippendorff's alpha, RMSE).

prompt.location: Figure 2 (representative prompt-template examples for CHA2DS2-VASc); Supplementary material said to hold full templates (not present in the extracted text)
prompt.note: A core prompt template is reused per score component across all 5 tested LLMs.

claim.metric: RMSE, HAS-BLED score, LLM Pipeline configuration
claim.location: Supplementary Table 4, row GPT-4 Turbo, HAS-BLED/LLM Pipeline column (atrial-fibrillation cohort, n=179)

data.source: Single-center retrospective clinical cohort (AF ablation registry n=179, aortic-stenosis heart-team cohort n=76), Charite Berlin; paper states "(anonymized) data ... will be shared on reasonable request", not publicly posted

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is one of 5 LLMs run standalone and in an extraction-plus-deterministic-scoring pipeline over real, non-public patient records; results (RMSE and Krippendorff's alpha, with 95% CIs) are reported for all 3 risk scores. The underlying clinical-report inputs are not public and are available only on reasonable request to the authors, blocking prompt-level reproduction regardless of prompt/claim quality.
